purpose: Teach: 動脈/省令/偵察/定理/不合理/非行/射殺/勃発

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の動脈損傷の状況を警察、確認されてますね
lines.en: In this case, the police have confirmed the arterial damage to the victim, correct?
lines.style: Measured, methodical inquiry. Cool distance in the voice. Waiting for confirmation rather than asking—a statement turned upward at the end. Eyes steady, shoulders still.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、省令改正に基づき捜査基準を見直します
lines.en: The police department will be reviewing our investigation criteria based on the new ordinance amendments.
lines.style: Formal, institutional tone. Each phrase lands with equal weight. No inflection that suggests personal opinion. A statement of procedure, delivered without apology or hesitation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、上空偵察の結果を警察、お持ちですね
lines.en: In this case, you have the results from the aerial reconnaissance, don't you?
lines.style: Quiet persistence. The question is polite but assumes cooperation. Lean forward slightly with the inquiry. Patient, not confrontational.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪統計の数学的定理を学習しております
lines.en: The police are currently studying the mathematical foundations of criminal statistics.
lines.style: Steady, bureaucratic delivery. No urgency in the pacing. Each word placed deliberately. Speaking from prepared notes or established protocol.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、不合理な裁定を警察、不服とされてますね
lines.en: In this case, the police have expressed dissatisfaction with the unreasonable ruling, haven't they?
lines.style: Calm restatement of fact, checking alignment. Slight lift at the end—inviting agreement rather than demanding it. Professional courtesy masking a sharper question.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、青少年非行への対応に力を入れております
lines.en: The police are placing significant emphasis on our response to juvenile delinquency.
lines.style: Formal commitment. Measured pace. The word 'significant' carries understated weight. Speaking as institutional voice, not personal opinion.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、要人射殺未遂の事件を警察、捜査されてますね
lines.en: In this case, the police are investigating the attempted assassination of a high-ranking official, correct?
lines.style: Deliberate, careful phrasing. Each word chosen with precision. The gravity of the allegation sits underneath calm delivery. Waiting for the answer to land.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、暴動勃発に備えております
lines.en: The police are prepared for potential civil unrest.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. No elaboration. Authority in the brevity. Factual statement delivered with quiet conviction—this is settled, this is ready.
